train_adaboost_classifier: train an AdaBoostClassifier with DecisionTreeClassifier weak learners on multi-class data
create_multiclass_dataset: create a multi-class classification dataset using Gaussian quantiles with configurable samples and features
evaluate_boosting_convergence: evaluate AdaBoost convergence by tracking misclassification error across boosting iterations
analyze_weak_learner_weights: analyze weak learner training errors and ensemble weights from a fitted AdaBoostClassifier
split_train_test_dataset: split a dataset into training and test sets with configurable train size ratio
